description: Latest official baseline bytes, official schema and additional Coding Procedure remain unavailable. Original manual and local experimental protocol were consulted. Country code and universe remain provisional.
required_followup: Coordinator must recover official baseline and additional procedure before official comparison or contribution.

description: Open-web research does not reproduce LexisNexis. English and Italian generic searches, weekly literal-date and date-operator attempts, regional and sector searches were executed. Some pooled responses ignored constraints or returned unrelated dates. No systematic paid archive or official event universe was available.
required_followup: Continue original contemporary archive research and record genuinely empty searches separately from unrelated pooled returns.

description: Italian and English were searched. Regional discovery covered Rome, Milan, Turin, Naples, Palermo, Bologna, Florence/Prato, Veneto, Trento, Cagliari/Sardinia, Calabria and Taranto; depth is uneven. Dialect and minority-language sources were not systematically searched.
required_followup: Extend undercovered regions and local-language archives; lack of discovered reports is not absence.

description: Many physical actions lack attendance. Workforce affected, schools represented, association counts, national strike totals, signatures, vehicles and online participation are not local gathering attendance.
required_followup: Seek contemporary local crowd estimates, preserving lower credible conflicting estimates.

description: School campaign links do not authorize automatic city/day splitting or merging. January 7, 11, 13, 18, 22 and 29 records require coordinated national versus distinct local review. Earlier outdoor lessons are not automatically the January 7 Turin flashmob.
required_followup: Compare organizers, actual physical onset and continuity before consolidation.

description: Turin gym page has January 18 header but explicitly dates the physical action December 18. January announcement and ANSA-derived copies do not resolve occurrence month. No established prior-month qualifying continuation was assigned; continuations array is empty for that evidentiary reason.
required_followup: Find accessible original ANSA occurrence and independently dated local report. If December onset established, transfer to prior-month ownership rather than create January start.

description: Actual HTTP 403 denials were respected. Several tool cache failures recovered by ordinary HTTPS to the identical public URL; this is retrieval, not corroboration. Twelve source cards are blocked, including Sesto hospital, Calabria farmers, Cagliari USB workplace-safety and rail-policy, Naples school and gaming-sector companions.
required_followup: Seek accessible independent contemporary originals without bypassing denial, login or paywalls.

description: ANSA reports and supplied copies share origin; AGIMEG supplied the Repubblica gaming report. Organizer strike calls supply demands but not actual gatherings. Discovery card count is not independent confirmations.
required_followup: Map common origins and distinguish call, occurrence report and independent corroboration.

description: All seven responses remain unknown unless directly evidenced. Trento prefect reception and Sotacarbo council meeting support accommodation. Supportive mayor video, MPs' future representation, earlier government meetings, route guards and traffic closure do not establish meeting, ignore or crowd dispersal.
required_followup: Seek actual event-specific response evidence; preserve unknown otherwise.

description: No physical closure date is securely established for the candidate units. Article dates, scheduled strike duration, return to work and intended movement do not supply closure.
required_followup: Seek explicit physical end or cessation evidence before assigning end dates.

description: IoApro opening and commercial dining are not automatically a public protest gathering. A wine-venue subgroup is below fifty; Milan article's multiple venues are not one crowd. Trieste dinner has thirty diners.
required_followup: Verify a specific qualifying physical gathering, domestic demand and actual attendance without treating fines as crowd.

description: Naples local port solidarity centers private dismissals while original national strike call includes domestic public policy demands. Campaign linkage and local demand scope require review. Palermo Open Arms accountability target needs more precise documentation.
required_followup: Verify domestic state demand at eligible physical unit rather than infer it from private grievances.

description: Some ordinary HTTPS recoveries were bounded body prefixes. Source limitations identify partial reads; no video playback or systematic photograph counts were performed.
required_followup: Read remaining accessible relevant body sections when they could resolve specific fields; do not treat prefix as complete article.

description: Remaining discovery includes ex-Ilva salary-support call, January 26 worker archive entry, housing rent-bonus announcement, online Non Una Di Meno assembly and February 1 Campidoglio call. None is proof of a qualifying January physical gathering; pollution letters and signatures do not establish attendance.
required_followup: Follow accessible occurrence originals for labor, environmental and housing leads; preserve online-only and future calls separately from executed gatherings.
